The site build refuses a bundle whose explorer/contract.json read_model_version differs from EXPECTED_READ_MODEL_VERSION (site main 14, PR #24 15, core develop 16; explorer/scripts/explorer-build-contract.mjs:5 in the site, results-explorer/scripts/explorer-build-contract.mjs:6 in core). The first failed deploy, run 38247176462 at 2026-10-12 12:09Z, stopped on exactly this ("expected 14, got 15 ... update the Explorer for the new contract before taking this bundle").

The batch record said not to merge #24 until a v15+ bundle deploys. That cannot happen: the Explorer must change first. Merging is safe because a failed deploy stops before publish.
